title: Echo River Ranch
specs: Wooded trails, mountain views, fresh air
blurb: Echo River Ranch offers guided horseback rides year-round on slow-paced, beginner-friendly trails near Enumclaw, Washington. Rides feature wooded trails, mountain views, and fresh air. The owner and guide has over 40 years of experience and provides insights on local plants and foraging during seasonal rides.
extraNote: Rides are by appointment only · Echo River Ranch, about five miles northeast of Enumclaw, Washington · Year-round, rain or shine
